# Business Glossary - E-Commerce Domain (Simplified)

This document defines the core business concepts for the e-commerce platform test dataset.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CUSTOMER
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Definition**: An individual or entity registered on the platform who has made at least one purchase.

**Business Context**: Customers are the primary actors in the e-commerce system. They browse products, place orders, an... [TRUNCATED]

**Business Context**: Line items break down orders into individual product purchases. Each captures the price at the moment of ordering.

**Key Attributes**:
- Unique line identifier
- References exactly one Product
- Quantity of units ordered
- Unit price at time of order (historical, not current)
- Extended amount = quantity × unit price

**Business Rules**:
- A Sales Order must contain at least one line item
- Cannot be modified after order confirmation
- Unit price is fixed and does not chan... [TRUNCATED]

Sales Order Relationships:
- A Sales Order is placed by exactly one Customer
- A Sales Order has one or more Order Line Items
- A Sales Order has one or more Payments
- A Sales Order has one or more Shipments

Order Line Item Relationships:
- An Order Line Item is part of exactly one Sales Order
- An Order Line Item references exactly one Product

Payment Relationships:
- A Payment is for exactly one Sales Order

Shipment Relationships:
- A Shipment is for exactly one Sales Order
- A Shipment co... [TRUNCATED]

## MODIFIED FOR TEST A
Refund: A reimbursement issued to a customer when an order is cancelled.

## SECOND MODIFICATION — extra term
Return Policy: Products can be returned within 30 days of purchase for a full refund.

entities_post_resolution.name: Line Item
entities_post_resolution.definition: A line item is a single product entry in a sales order that records the product, the quantity ordered, the unit price at the time of ordering, and the extended amount (quantity × unit price).
entities_post_resolution.provenance_text:
**Business Context**: Line items break down orders into individual product purchases. Each captures the price at the moment of ordering. | **Key Attributes**:
- Unique line identifier
- References exactly one Product
- Quantity of units ordered
- Unit price at time of order (historical, not current)
- Extended amount = quantity × unit price | - Line 1: 2 units of Wireless Headphones at €79.99 each

entities_post_resolution.name: Order
entities_post_resolution.definition: An order is a business record representing a customer's instruction to purchase products, containing line items with prices at the time of ordering and potential refunds if the order is cancelled.
entities_post_resolution.provenance_text: **Business Context**: Line items break down orders into individual product purchases. Each captures the price at the moment of ordering. | Refund: A reimbursement issued to a customer when an order is cancelled. | Synonyms: order, purchase order, transaction, customer order

entities_post_resolution.name: Order Line Item
entities_post_resolution.definition: A single line item that belongs to one Sales Order, representing a distinct product/service entry (quantity and price) within that order.
entities_post_resolution.provenance_text:
Key Attributes:
- Unique Order ID
- References exactly one Customer
- Order date when transaction was initiated
- Total monetary value
- Status: PENDING, CONFIRMED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED
- Must contain at least one Order Line Item | Order Line Item Relationships:
- An Order Line Item is part of exactly one Sales Order | Order Line Item Relationships:
- An Order Line Item references exactly

entities_post_resolution.name: Payment
entities_post_resolution.definition: A Payment is a transactional record representing a monetary payment associated with a Sales Order, including a unique payment ID, method, amount, timestamp, and status, where an order may have one or more Payments and payments must be confirmed before shipment.
entities_post_resolution.provenance_text:
**Key Attributes**:
- Unique Payment ID
- References exactly one Sales Order
- Payment method (credit card, PayPal, bank transfer)
- Payment amount
- Confirmation timestamp
- Status: PENDING, CONFIRMED, FAILED, REFUNDED | **Business Rules**:
- Payment must be confirmed before order ships | Payment Relationships:
- A Payment is for exactly one Sales Order | Payment          → PAYMENT | Sales Order

entities_post_resolution.name: Shipment
entities_post_resolution.definition: A Shipment represents a single consignment of goods dispatched from a source warehouse to a destination customer, identified by a unique Shipment ID and tracked by status, timestamps, and delivery details, and linked to a Sales Order.
entities_post_resolution.provenance_text:
**Key Attributes**:
- Unique Shipment ID
- References exactly one Sales Order
- Source Warehouse
- Destination Customer Address
- Shipped timestamp
- Tracking number
- Status: PREPARING, SHIPPED, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED | **Business Rules**:
- Can only be created for confirmed orders with payment | Shipment Relationships:
- A Shipment is for exactly one Sales Order | Shipment Relationships:
- A Ship

tables_enriched.name: customer_master
tables_enriched.description: Stores core customer information, including identity, contact details, regional assignment, creation timestamp, and active status.

tables_enriched.name: tb_product
tables_enriched.description: Stores product catalog information including identification, naming, category, pricing, and active status for the product catalog.

tables_enriched.name: tb_category
tables_enriched.description: Stores information about product categories, including each category's name and its parent category for hierarchical categorization.

tables_enriched.name: Sales Order Header
tables_enriched.description: Stores the header information for sales orders, including identifiers, dates, amounts, status, and timestamps for payment confirmation, delivery, and creation.

tables_enriched.name: Order Line Item
tables_enriched.description: Stores the individual items that make up each order, including the product, quantity, pricing, and total line amount for each line item.

tables_enriched.name: Payment
tables_enriched.description: Stores records of payments associated with customer orders, including method, amount, status, and timestamps for confirmation and creation.

tables_enriched.name: Shipment
tables_enriched.description: Stores records of shipments associated with customer orders, including where and when shipments were sent, tracking details, and current status.
